minutes.headline: Board approved an earth removal permit 3-2 with conditions; denied firearm hunting on conservation land 3-2.
minutes.summary: The Select Board denied a request to hunt with firearms on town conservation land, licensed a new auto dealer, and, after a long hearing with abutters objecting, approved a 50,000 cubic yard earth removal permit with conditions. The town manager presented the FY21-25 five-year financial forecast and the FY21 capital plan, and the superintendent discussed the school staffing plan, which drew sharp objections from one member. Routine appointments, a power broker agreement and a charter letter were also handled.

public_comment.topic: Two residents asked permission to hunt with firearms on town conservation land.
Conservation Commission land use policy prohibits firearm discharge on its land except Hunting Hill; spoke as himself.
Abutter at 68 Townsend Harbor Road objected to dust, noise, septic risk and three years of earth removal.
Abutter at 70 Townsend Harbor Road objected to scale of removal, truck traffic, and the original ten yard letter; said he would sell.
Asked engineer whether abutters' septic systems were considered.
Finance Committee member said the forecast leaves out unplanned debt so the committee can see wiggle room.

Have the chair sign the town charter letter to the state representative and senator.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a 50,000 cubic yard earth removal permit at 1325 Mass Ave, 3-2, with conditions on hours, dust control, no rock crushing and screening.
A motion to postpone the earth removal hearing to February 11 and invite the building commissioner and land-use director failed.
The board voted 3-2 not to permit hunting with firearms on the town conservation land parcels.
The town manager presented the FY21-25 five-year forecast; the board agreed to add a weekly budget and forecast item to its agendas until Town Meeting.
The January 28 meeting will be a public forum on the five-year forecast and capital plan instead of a regular meeting.

why_it_matters: The earth removal permit allows several years of excavation and truck traffic next to homes on Townsend Harbor Road, and its conditions are the main protection for neighbors on dust, hours and septic systems.
The forecast and the school staffing plan bear on the next tax bill and on what Town Meeting will be asked to fund, and the January 28 forum is the scheduled chance for residents to speak on them.
